question.text: The solution of $\operatorname{det}\left(A-\lambda I_2\right)=0$ be 4 and 8 and $A=\left(\begin{array}{ll}2 & 3 \\ x & y\end{array}\right)$. Then

solution.text:
$\operatorname{det}\left(A-\lambda I_2\right)=0 \Rightarrow\left|\begin{array}{cc}2-\lambda & 3 \\ x & y-\lambda\end{array}\right|=0$
$\begin{array}{ll}
\Rightarrow & (2-\lambda)(y-\lambda)-3 x=0 \\
\Rightarrow & 2 y-\lambda y-2 \lambda+\lambda^2-3 x=0 \\
\Rightarrow & \lambda^2-(y+2) \lambda+2 y-3 x=0 \\
& y+2=4+8 \Rightarrow y=10 \\
& \text { and } 2 y-3 x=4 \times 8 \Rightarrow x=-4
\end{array}$
